description: This Java class 'RemoteJsInvokeService' extends 'AbstractJsInvokeService' and manages remote JavaScript invocation, including script compilation, invocation, and release via message queues, with support for concurrency, error handling, and statistics.

classes.name: RemoteJsInvokeService
classes.description: A service class for remote JavaScript invocation, handling script compilation, invocation, and release through message queues with concurrency and error management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service and request template.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and shuts down executor and request template.

methods.name: doEval
methods.description: Compiles a script remotely and stores its info upon success.

methods.name: doInvokeFunction
methods.description: Invokes a remote JavaScript function with arguments.

methods.name: buildJsInvokeRequest
methods.description: Builds a request message for invoking a JavaScript function.

methods.name: handleInvokeError
methods.description: Handles errors during invocation, including retries for not found errors.

methods.name: doRelease
methods.description: Releases a script from remote execution, removing stored script info.

methods.name: constructFunctionName
methods.description: Constructs a function name based on script hash.

methods.name: getScriptHash
methods.description: Retrieves the script hash for a given script ID.
